name: New Era
verdict: Family-owned by the founding Koch family of Buffalo (not Koch, Inc.); ACON Investments holds a significant stake. Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of the LIV Golf League since 2024 (livgolf.com news announcement); logo appears on every team page, including Torque GC's. Also NFL/NBA/MLB minority investors in the company (AP, 2024-06-06).
